thread:
pranav: Quick ask — can someone run a short canary comparing KV-prefix cache impact across A100 / H100 / L40S for the long-ctx workload? Nightly shows H100 p99 spikes and I want to confirm it's cache behavior, not a scheduler/regression.

marta: What exact metrics & configs do you want measured? p50/p95/p99, throughput, memory? Which image/driver?

pranav: p50/p95/p99, tokens/s throughput, GPU mem peak, and nvlink % (if available). Also record cold vs warm (first request vs repeated). Use runtime image `dev-runtime:prod-gpu-stable-2026` and run fp16 and q4_0 variants. Model: `redwood/r-infer-7b` (8k context). Run seq_len 4k/8k, batch_size 1 and 4. Smallish sample set: 30 traces each so this is a quick canary, not full sweep.

ken: I can pick this up tonight on the lab rack. Do you want any kernel flags toggled (nvcomp, thinbatch)? or default perf config?

pranav: Default perf config for baseline. If time, run with `--thinbatch=true` as a follow-up. Main goal: compare cache warmup effect across SKUs.

alexa: Also capture per-request latency hist (or p99 from our bench tool) and KV cache hit ratio if bench exposes it — that's key. For H100, check oom/evict logs (KV eviction can cause p99 blips).

benchbot: Scheduled quick job: job_id=rb-bench-2098765432-1. Running A100,H100,L40S on sequence configs: {seq4k,b1},{seq4k,b4},{seq8k,b1}. Will post summarized numbers in ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

benchbot: Partial results (warm = after 10 warmups):
- A100 (fp16, seq4k, b1): p50=12ms p95=38ms p99=62ms t/s=1800 gpu_mem=22GB
- H100 (fp16, seq4k, b1): p50=11ms p95=42ms p99=70ms t/s=1850 gpu_mem=21GB
- L40S (fp16, seq4k, b1): p50=13ms p95=40ms p99=68ms t/s=1750 gpu_mem=20GB
Note: H100 p99 ~+12% vs A100 in this quick warm run. Will post q4_0 and cold-run numbers soon.

marta: Can you paste the exact command you used for the run so I can reproduce? Also which driver?

ken: ```
./rb_bench --model redwood/r-infer-7b --variant fp16 --seq_len 4096 --batch 1 --warmups 10 --iters 30 --image dev-runtime:prod-gpu-stable-2026 --report-format short --record-kv-stats
```
Driver: nvidia-driver 535.xx on all SKUs (same infra image).

alexa: Good. Once q4_0 and cold runs land let's compare warm-up curves. If H100 consistently higher p99 on warm, might be eviction pattern. If only cold, may be kernel startup.

benchbot: Full summary posted: job_id=rb-bench-2098765432-1/results (short paste):
- cold warm delta (H100, seq4k,b1,fp16): cold p99=210ms -> warm p99=70ms (big warmup)
- q4_0 brings p99 down ~8-10% across SKUs but relative H100 delta vs A100 persists
- seq8k,b1 shows similar pattern; batch4 reduces relative p99 gap (higher throughput but more variance)

pranav: Thanks team. If numbers hold after more runs, we'll update routing policy to prefer A100 for longctx b1 FP16 workloads and tag H100 as "preferred for throughputy workloads" in the docs. @alexa can you open a follow-up issue to track canary replication + routing change?

alexa: Yep, will open issue and include scripts + raw logs. cc @marta for validation steps. :white_check_mark:

ken: I'll run one more replicate with `--thinbatch=true` and attach logs here tomorrow AM.

pranav: Perfect — appreciate the quick turn.
